info.name: Construction.Account.Admin Account Management Issue Types API

params.name: include
params.description: Use include=subtypes to include the types (subtypes) for each category (type).

params.name: limit
params.description: Add limit=20 to limit the results count (together with the offset to support pagination).

params.name: offset
params.description: Add offset=20 to get partial results (together with the limit to support pagination).

params.name: filter[updatedAt]
params.description: Retrieves types that were last updated at the specified date and time, in in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

params.name: filter[isActive]
params.description: Filter types by status e.g. filter[isActive]=true will only return active types. Default value: undefined (meaning both active & inactive issue type categories will return).

items.docs: Retrieves a project’s categories and types.
